name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard Terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, for two parties to protect confidential information they share.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the deal-specific terms; incorporates the Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for a vendor providing cloud/SaaS services to a customer, with Order Forms.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms (uptime, support response and remedies) to accompany a cloud service agreement.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms governing a processor handling personal data on behalf of a controller, for data protection compliance.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for a customer who gives early feedback on a pre-release product in exchange for access.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement for a provider delivering professional services to a customer, with statements of work.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement between two companies to partner, such as referral, resale or co-marketing.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate terms for handling protected health information.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard agreement for licensing software to a customer, with Order Forms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement letting a prospective customer trial a product before a full commercial deal.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum adding terms on AI use, training data and outputs to an existing agreement.
